gaps.note: The front prints eight lamps and the two jack lamps of each RJ45. No held document gives the colours or meanings, so each lamp states only off and is drawn off. The photograph shows the jack lamps green, sampled #358844 over 20 px, and the other lamps dark. The four signal lamps are small rectangles in the photograph. They are drawn as the library's round lamp, a stand-in for the shape.

cellular.note: Data sheet: ACM7004-2-L has a 4G LTE modem (Sierra Wireless EM7565, Cat-12) and two SIM card slots. Quick start, page 3: slide the carrier mini SIM into the slot with the contacts facing up. The rear photograph labels the antenna jacks (M), a satellite symbol and (A). The jacks are SMA by the registry's reading of the photograph (gold hex nut, centre pin). No document names the connector, which is recorded in the gaps.

chassis.note: Data sheet, Dimensions and Weight: 5 1/8 x 4 3/4 x 1 3/8 in, 13 x 12 x 3.5 cm, 0.6 kg. Form factor "Compact". The inch figures are 130.2 x 120.7 x 34.9 mm. The centimetre figures are used, as the user manual's appendix prints the same. The rack kit 590003 and the DIN rail kit 590012 are accessories and no source dimensions them, so the body is drawn alone.

front-layout.note: Method: the ACM7004-2-L front photograph of the Quick Start Guide is measured against the 130 mm data sheet width. It is 718 px wide, straight on, with no scale marker, so 5.5 px/mm across. The data sheet's front photograph (626 x 343) agrees on the shared features to about 1 mm. Every position on the front is read off the photograph, good to about 0.7 mm. These are the two RJ45 jacks, the lamps and their symbols, the two SIM slots and the printing.

io.note: Data sheet, I/O Ports: 2 TTL level digital I/O ports (DIO) 5 V DC max at 20 mA. It also lists 2 high voltage digital outputs (HVDO) 5-30 V DC at 100 mA. The rear prints DC O2 G O1 G I2 G I1 under an eight-position header. The kit lists a black terminal block that plugs into it.

lamps.note: The front photograph shows four lamps at the left. A power symbol, a heartbeat symbol, IOIO and an antenna symbol sit beside them. Four signal lamps sit at the right of the SIM slots beside a signal-bar symbol. All eight are dark in the photograph. This model has no SFP cage and so no cage marks. No document held gives a colour or a meaning for any of them, so each is drawn off and states are a gap.

livery.note: The red and black front, the two diagonal stripes, the wordmark and the printing are read off the front photograph. They are painted livery, not parts. The red is the photograph's sampled median, #fa0024 over 800 px. The logo mark is a simplified outline.

network.note: Data sheet: ACM7004-2 has 2 x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports. The front photograph prints NET1 and NET2 over two RJ45 jacks, each with a lamp at each top corner. ACM700x-2 Quick Start Guide, page 1, steps 03 and 04: NET1 connects to the primary network and NET2 to the out-of-band management network. That guide covers the ACM7004-2, which the -L fits with a modem. NET1 is a traffic port and NET2 a management port.

power.note: Data sheet: 110-240 V AC to 12 V DC external power adapter, consumption less than 11.5 W. ACM700x-2 Quick Start Guide, page 1, kit table: the 12V switching DC power supply in the box is part 450031. Data sheet optional supplies are 450037 (12 VDC four chamber square connector), 450039 (AC adapter with a 4-pin connector) and 450041 (DC-DC converter). The rear prints 9~30V DC under a four-position housing, with a line over four dashes. The user manual's appendix says less than 30 W for all models. The data sheet's 11.5 W is followed. The appendix gives 5 to 50 C ambient where the data sheet gives -25 to 60 C. The data sheet is followed.

rear-layout.note: Method: the ACM7004-2-L rear photograph of the Quick Start Guide is 1127 px wide. The body is 1075 px across for 130 mm (8.27 px/mm). It is 288 px high for 35 mm (8.23 px/mm), so the face is orthographic to about 1 percent. The serial block, the SMA jacks and the USB ports are read off it. So are the digital I/O header and the power housing, good to about 0.5 mm.

serial.note: Data sheet: ACM7004-2 has 4 RJ45 RS-232 "Cisco straight" pinout console ports, 50 to 230,400 bps. The photograph numbers the ports 1 and 2 on the left and 3 and 4 on the right. It prints SERIAL above the left column.

serial-role.note: The serial ports are console server ports. ACM700x-2 Quick Start Guide, page 3, "Configure managed devices": set the Console Server Mode radio button for a port. The data sheet calls them "console ports".

sides.note: The outlines are drawn from the data sheet's stated size. The data sheet photograph shows the top lid at an angle as a plain dark slab, with no detail to place. No held picture shows the bottom or either side. The user manual says the connection status can be seen from the LEDs on top of the device.

Resilience Gateway Quick Start Guide for the ACM7004-2-L, ACM7008-2-L and ACM7004-5-L (06052019), page 2: the front and rear photographs with callouts. ACM7000 front photograph published on the data sheet. ACM700x-2 Quick Start Guide (revision 1.0.0), page 1: the kit contents.

usb.note: Data sheet: 4 x USB 2.0 console ports. The rear photograph shows two stacked pairs of USB-A jacks, numbered 1 and 2 on the left and 3 and 4 on the right. The user manual, section 3.1.8, puts the ACM7008-2 USB ports on the front. The photograph and the quick start callout put them on the rear, and the drawing follows the photograph.
